3. Interparliamentary Union. Each power enjoys an equal elective power. (art. 12)
4. International Law Union. An equal number of votes. (art. 3 cf. art. 3 of the Covenant.)
5. Denmark. Equal number of votes for all states. (art. 2 cf. art. 3 of the Covenant.)
6. Norway. Same as Denmark. (art. 2 cf. art. 3 of the Covenant.)
7. Netherlands. Different states may have different number of votes. (art. 4)
8. Sweden.
9. Switzerland. Same as Denmark. (art. 13 cf. art. 3 of the Covenant.)
10. Italy.
11. Germany. Equal number of votes. (art. 14)
12. Austria. Equal number of votes. (art. 13 cf. art. 3 of the Covenant.)
